checks.name: scope:igzo_2d_laptop_teaching_model_only
checks.detail: 2D n-IGZO electron-only drift-diffusion teaching model with the T02-A enabled symmetric dual-gate stack

checks.name: source:e1_process_mismatch_is_explicit
checks.detail: The project uses a dual gate, 30 nm physical Al2O3 on each side, 24 nm IGZO, ideal contacts, and no anneal process model; source values constrain a sensitivity range only.

checks.name: model:units_and_neutral_reference_are_explicit_assumptions
checks.detail: D_it[cm^-2 eV^-1] times a one-electron surface-energy shift numerically equal to DeltaPotential[V] gives cm^-2; multiplication by q gives C/cm^2 and dQ/dV=q*D_it gives F/cm^2.

checks.name: model:dynamic_bulk_and_double_interface_claims_blocked
checks.detail: This is a quasi-static linearized charge response about Psi_neutral, not a finite energy-distribution or capture-emission model. D_it controls only the bottom interface; applying the same number to both interfaces would double count a single-interface literature value. No bulk tail/deep states, trap-assisted recombination, time constants, hysteresis, bias stress, border traps, or temperature dependence are represented. The literature D_it values are not project measurements or fitted parameters.

checks.name: acceptance:zero_limit_continuity_gauss_and_coupled_gates_frozen
checks.detail: zero-limit, potential continuity, Gauss closure, current conservation, and response direction are mandatory

checks.name: boundary:equation_smoke_does_not_complete_scan_or_p2
checks.detail: After contract, smoke, and independent persisted-evidence checks pass, T03-P2-DIT may claim only that a literature-constrained bottom-interface D_it range and a quasi-static DEVSIM sheet-charge equation have passed zero-limit, convergence, continuity, and Gauss-law smoke tests in the frozen teaching model.

evidence_boundary.allowed_claim: After contract, smoke, and independent persisted-evidence checks pass, T03-P2-DIT may claim only that a literature-constrained bottom-interface D_it range and a quasi-static DEVSIM sheet-charge equation have passed zero-limit, convergence, continuity, and Gauss-law smoke tests in the frozen teaching model.
prohibited_claims: completed D_it sensitivity or completed P2 trap group
reported SS, VTH, Ioff, Ion, or mobility trend from a formal trap scan
experimental calibration, process prediction, measured project D_it, or uncertainty
dynamic capture-emission, hysteresis, bias-stress, reliability, or border-trap validation
bulk N_tail or N_deep trap evidence
both-interface trap validation or complete T03 five-group sensitivity
compact-model, circuit, layout, or HZO evidence
evidence_boundary.next_gate: Only a passed equation smoke plus independent check permits the separate minimum three-point T03-P2-DIT transfer sensitivity; P3, P5, SPICE, and layout remain closed.
